name: 世道
detailed_description:
Different fairy world, the same fairy dream
I am very glad to meet you here. I believe that every Taoist friend who likes to cultivate the immortal also enters this vast world with a chivalrous heart. The road to cultivating the immortal is long, and while practicing various Daoisms, it is also about cultivating the heart and morality. May every Tao friend find his or her own "Tao" in the world of cultivating the immortal!
The game uses a hybrid worldview, and the world of fairy cultivation on this continent is also a non-traditional fairy world. There are monks, monks, wizards, wizards, holy sisters, nuns, priests, warriors, bandits, thieves, rascals, officials, believers, followers, and all kinds of diabolical demons and ghosts, and living in the hell like the gap between survival of the homeless people.

Open world
The game adopts the open-world mode of God's overlooking perspective. Players walk through every piece of land on the map through God's perspective, objectively look at the sentient beings and human suffering in the game, and experience the things that are not easy and life is varied.

Multiple plot
Non-linear story, no specific main mission. Plot features are driven by the player's willingness to engage in novelistic conversations with NPCS, and every choice and decision the player makes will affect the development and direction of the story. You can choose which NPCS you want to recruit as teammates on your spiritual path, and NPCS have the right to choose whether to join your team or not.

A different demon
There are many monsters in the game, and the definition of monsters is different from the mainstream form. Game people, gods, demons, ghosts, demons five forces, as well as scattered scattered people. Any object may become a "demon" (including the player) because of a mistake, and any "demon" may also become a "non-demon" because of chance and transition. As in the game, you may meet the evil demon who is beautiful and wise side by side, the handsome and cheerful big boy who is loved but abuses his ability to take away in private, or the toad demon who often relief the homeless people, or the ugly maggot demon who has a wide friendship and sacrifices his body to cut flesh.

Add content and features
At present, the game is mainly based on the growth of RPG adventure style, and in the future, it will continue to enrich the world view and plot of the game, and consider adding herbal planting system, herbal medicine, sorcerer refining system, force relationship warring system, good and evil judgment reward and punishment system (such as: Do a lot of evil to do a good job of the lightning storm that may be suffered after random days, a strong character may come to become a teammate after a wide friendship), and the goodwill and loyalty system of interacting with NPCS.
